title: rosa canina subvar. vinealis
intro: Rosa canina subvar. vinealis, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a variant of the Rosa canina species, a flowering shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. vinealis include its anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular remedy for skin conditions and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
